title: Update on Nov. 26
conclusion: All 19 balance items reviewed. 8 combat items adapted in client simulator (baijia_passive_hooks.js, baijia_combat_hooks.js, yisim/card_actions.js, baijia_combat_contracts.json) and verified by test_nov26_balance_v357.py (10/10 pass) + test_baijia_passives.py + test_oct29_combat.py: Carrier Body (2015), Tempered Blade - Cloud Sea (7130), Rat Steals Oil (7116), Plan Before Acting (7110), Spirit Covers Mountains and Rivers (7087), Spirit Feather (7060), Dream: Heavenly Time Recurring (D27015), Mirage: Raven Spirit Sword (714031-714033). The remaining 11 items are preparation-phase / exchange-chance / round-timing / destiny-cost adjustments read directly from live memory. Base cards 214 (Jade Scroll of Yin Symbol) and 381 (Spirit Feather) were not modified; those warnings came from immortal fate mentions (items 004 and 010).
